title: Define the project
description: Set the project scope, review precedent vehicles, and establish initial requirements.

title: Refine the response concept
description: Focus the high-speed FPV drone on stereo scene mapping, with synchronized cameras and SLAM running on a ground computer.

title: Design the airframe
description: Develop and compare frame concepts for fast, stable FPV flight while carrying a stereo camera pair.

title: Select motors and propellers
description: Evaluate motors, propellers, and batteries for a possible speed near 100 mph, accounting for camera payload and flight time.

title: Plan stereo capture and data link
description: Select two cameras and an IMU; define FPGA capture timing, frame IDs, buffering, and transmission to the ground computer.

title: Simulate flight and failsafes
description: Use simulation to estimate thrust, stability, and return-home behavior, and test the stereo SLAM data flow with recorded frames.

title: Build the first prototype
description: Assemble the airframe, propulsion system, stereo cameras, IMU, and FPGA for testing.

title: Bench and flight testing
description: Measure thrust, tune flight control, and verify synchronized frames, capture timestamps, and the data link during controlled flight.

title: Integrate and demonstrate
description: Run stereo SLAM on the ground computer using paired camera frames and IMU data, then demonstrate a simulated emergency-response mission.
